verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own background automations that run without user intervention: the notetaker can be scheduled to auto-join all Zoom/Teams/Meet meetings, and meeting outputs are automatically synced to a CRM, pushed to Airtable, or turned into Zendesk/ServiceNow tickets. These are fixed, meeting-triggered integration flows rather than a general user-defined automation builder, and the evidence gives no detail on configuring triggers, conditions, or recurring schedules beyond meeting events. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable automation/rules builder, non-meeting triggers or recurring schedules, depth on how 'trigger actions based on meeting content' is set up, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Schedule your AI Meeting Notetaker to automatically join all your Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet meetings.
Key deal details, notes, and next steps automatically extracted from every meeting and synced to your CRM.
Automatically turn meeting takeaways into support tickets or updates in tools like Zendesk and ServiceNow.
Otter automatically sends transcripts, summaries, and meeting metadata to Airtable.
Teams can automatically ingest meeting transcripts into internal knowledge bases or trigger actions based on meeting content
